look.summary_zh: 暖色 · 提亮中灰 · 中段拉开
look.description_zh: 50% 灰输出 Y′ 154.8/255（变化 +27.3 码值）；25%–75% 灰跨度比 1.200。中灰红减蓝 +3.5 码值。浅/中/深肤色色块分别输出 #F5E6DA、#E5AE86、#9C6129；红/绿/蓝测试块分别输出 #EA3B1C、#74CA85、#6644D7。
look.description_en: 50% gray Y′ 154.8/255 (+27.3 code values); 25–75% gray span ratio 1.200; mid-gray red minus blue +3.5 code values. Light/medium/deep skin swatches: #F5E6DA, #E5AE86, #9C6129. Red/green/blue swatches: #EA3B1C, #74CA85, #6644D7.
look.suggested_use_zh: 暖色生活、餐饮与怀旧试片
look.suggested_use_en: Compare on your own SDR product, portrait and landscape footage before selecting.
look.cautions_zh: 逐项比较肤色与品牌色，强度过高可能改变产品颜色。仅像素颜色映射，不生成颗粒、光晕、暗角、空间雾或美颜；未做自然画质验收。
look.cautions_en: Pixel color mapping only; no grain, glow, vignette, spatial haze or beauty effects. Natural footage quality is unaccepted. Check skin/product colors and clipped output.
